description: Deposit figure stated in words; transfer promised for a weekday.

segments.text: Hi, I need to know exactly how much deposit I have to pay on the purchase.
The purchase price is two hundred and fifty thousand pounds and the contract asks for a ten per cent deposit, so that is twenty five thousand pounds.
And when does that need to be in?
We need the deposit in our client account by Monday the 19th of October, ahead of exchange.
Fine. I'll transfer it on Friday.
Please send me the transfer confirmation as soon as it's done and I'll confirm when it lands.
